recipe.visualDefinition: A medium studio portrait of a male figure in a navy military-style jacket with black braided frogging, set against a clean off-white background. The composition features heavy, interlocking sans-serif typography stacked in the upper right quadrant, utilizing a high-contrast red and black color scheme.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned off-center left to balance right-aligned text block
High-contrast relationship between the navy jacket and the neutral background
Visual weight shared between the subject's face/sunglasses and the bold red lettering
Vertical alignment of the text block edges with the subject's shoulder line
coreInvariants: Navy blue hussar-style jacket with prominent black frogging
Tight, overlapping letter spacing in the primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, shown from the waist up, slightly angled toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and dark sunglasses serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move right to the vibrant red display text, then drop down to the secondary black text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper left and lower right provides breathing room for the dense central elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white background provides a neutral canvas.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Navy blue and black in the clothing provide deep tonal contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red in the primary typography acts as the main visual hook.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the red text against low-saturation background and dark-valued clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight tracking causing glyphs to touch or overlap
characterSpecificRedesigns: Horizontal bars are elongated to bridge gaps between letters

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over background, adjacent to subject
aligned with right edge of display text

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Size and color contrast within the same typeface family.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight for the display text.
Geometric structure matches the modern urban feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a man with braided hair wearing large aviator sunglasses and a navy blue hussar-style jacket with black braided frogging over a white shirt. The background should be a clean, solid off-white. The subject should be positioned slightly to the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two levels of text in the upper right. The top level should be large, red, extra-bold sans-serif words stacked vertically with touching letters. The second level should be a single line of black bold sans-serif text directly underneath, right-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the red text touching or overlapping?
Is the background a clean, neutral off-white?
Does the jacket feature the specific military frogging detail?

adjustableVariables: Jacket color (e.g., olive green or black)
Subject pose (e.g., profile or full frontal)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original artist
Any trademarked logos on the sunglasses or clothing
Exact wording of the original album title

avoid: Loose kerning in the display font

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the sunglasses have a smooth gradient tint.
Check that the red text is the most vibrant element in the frame.
Verify the military jacket details are crisp and distinct.
Confirm the right-alignment of the text block is perfectly vertical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Military Detail Jacket + Geometric Stacked Typography + High Contrast Triad (Navy/Red/White)
